description: The moment Krishna creates a false eclipse to trick Jayadratha. The battlefield darkens. Jayadratha thinks the sun has set and Arjuna failed his oath. He emerges from hiding.

KAURAVA.note: Jayadratha in the center, behind Padma Vyuha defenders.

special_mechanics.false_eclipse: At turn 3, the sun 'disappears' (VNScene trigger). Jayadratha's guard drops. He becomes targetable for 2 turns before the ruse is revealed.
